camel_example: aliyun dcdn CreateDcdnDeliverTask --region cn-hangzhou --Deliver '{"email":{"subject":"主题名称","to":["username@example.com","username@example.org"]}}' --Schedule '{"schedName":"订阅任务名称","description":"描述","crontab":"000**?","frequency":"d","status":"enable","effectiveFrom":"2020-09-17T00:00:00Z","effectiveEnd":"2020-11-17T00:00:00Z"}' --Reports '[{\"reportId\":2,\"conditions\":[{\"field\":\"prov\",\"op\":\"in\",\"value\":[\"黑龙江\",\"北京\"]}]}]' --Name '域名订阅'
description_en: Creates a report subscription task. After the subscription succeeds, the system periodically sends report statistics to you by email
description_zh: 调用CreateDcdnDeliverTask创建报表订阅任务，订阅成功后系统会周期性地以邮件方式向您发送报表统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn create-dcdn-deliver-task --name '域名订阅' --reports '[{\"reportId\":2,\"conditions\":[{\"field\":\"prov\",\"op\":\"in\",\"value\":[\"黑龙江\",\"北京\"]}]}]' --deliver '{"email":{"subject":"主题名称","to":["username@example.com","username@example.org"]}}' --schedule '{"schedName":"订阅任务名称","description":"描述","crontab":"000**?","frequency":"d","status":"enable","effectiveFrom":"2020-09-17T00:00:00Z","effectiveEnd":"2020-11-17T00:00:00Z"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDcdnDeliverTask

parameters.help_en: The name of the subscription task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of reports to subscribe to. The value must be JSON-escaped
parameters.help_zh: 待订阅的报表列表，需进行JSON转义
parameters.name: reports

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The list of domain names to which you want to subscribe. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can subscribe to a maximum of 500 domain names. To subscribe to more than 500 domain names, submit an application (https://page.aliyun.com/form/act2017566026/index.htm).</props>

<props="intl">The list of domain names to which you want to subscribe. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can subscribe to a maximum of 500 domain names. To subscribe to more than 500 domain names, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex).</props>
If you do not specify this parameter, the system creates a report delivery task for all domain names under your account by default
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，订阅域名数量上限为500个，超过500个请提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)申请。</props>

<props="intl">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，订阅域名数量上限为500个，超过500个请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex)申请。</props>
不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名订阅报表交付任务
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The method for sending reports. Only email is supported. The value must be JSON-escaped
parameters.help_zh: 报表发送方式，仅支持邮件发送，需进行JSON转义
parameters.name: deliver

parameters.help_en: The parameters related to the subscription cycle. The value must be JSON-escaped
parameters.help_zh: 订阅周期相关参数，需进行JSON转义
parameters.name: schedule

DeliverId.description_en: The ID of the subscription task
